newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ABARE sees Australia uranium output, export up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ABARE sees Australia uranium output, export up.

text.p: Australian uranium mine output is expected to rise 11.7 percent in the year to June 30, 1997 compared with a 94 percent rise in 1995/96, the Australian Bureau of Agriculture and Resource Economics (ABARE) said on Tuesday.
In its September quarter Commodities bulletin, the government advisory body forecast 1996/97 production at 5,700 tonnes, up from 5,015 for 1995/96.
Australian uranium exports were forecast to increase on the back of the increased production which, in turn, would be prompted by higher prices, ABARE said.
Uranium exports in 1996/97 were expected to rise 17.3 percent to 6,200 tonnes, following a 30 percent rise in exports during 1995/96.

Energy Resources Of Australia's Ranger Mine in the Northern Territory would contribute to this increase with uranium output expected to increase to 4,000 tonnes in 1996/97 from 3,500 tonnes in 1995/96, ABARE said.
WMC Ltd's Olympic Dam project was expected to raise its exports to 2,200 tonnes in 1996/96, up from 1,653 tonnes in the previous year.
